recipes.notes: Official pinned video_to_data wrapper uses --rgb_path, despite its older README example using --video_path. The output is per-frame native MHR parameters and mesh, without temporal HOI refinement. Shared intrinsics avoid the optional standalone Body MoGe FOV download. Output existence alone does not establish full-frame coverage or reconstruction quality.

recipes.notes: CARI4D jointly estimates human MHR and rigid-object motion, starting from SAM 3D Body. The final refined.pth bundle contains per-frame 'frames' and a 'pr' block with MHR parameters; pipeline_report.json records stage identities. This group consumes additional Track 1-derived masks and metric mesh, so it is an ablation or end-to-end candidate, not a directly rankable independent-human baseline. Glob matches only confirm files exist, not complete frames or quality.
